flows.title: Create an index
steps: In the Algolia dashboard, go to the Indices tab.
Enter a name for the index and click Create.

flows.title: Upload a file of records to an index
steps: Open the index in the dashboard. An upload adds to the index being viewed and never deletes records.
Click Add records > Upload file. On an empty index, click Upload records > Upload file.
Drop the file into the Upload records box, or select it on the file system, then click Upload. A record whose object ID matches one already in the index replaces it.
When Algolia has indexed the data, the dashboard shows a success notification.
